p:Lax434175Proofs.Determined.batch_deter.label:
The word gives the kernel instance (header and records), the deadlines, sizes,
weights and due dates (records), and the precedence pairs with their lags (the
block); the constraints and the cost read nothing else.
p:Lax434175Proofs.Determined.batch_deter.tooltipHtml:
The word gives the kernel instance (header and records), the deadlines, sizes,
weights and due dates (records), and the precedence pairs with their lags (the
block); the constraints and the cost read nothing else.

p:Lax434175Proofs.Determined.ops_determi.label:
Parse the word (`ops_parse`): the two instances are one kernel instance with
data of the same views, and constraints and costs read only those
(`feasible_congr`).

p:Lax434175Proofs.Propagation.approxKept.label:
The same program: a word of an instance is a word of its lift, and the lift has
the same schedules, costs and total weight.

the same schedules, costs and total weight.

p:Lax434175Proofs.PropagationStandard.op.label:
Every part of a standard word is written by a view, and reading the data with
the more general values keeps every view; schedules are unchanged.
